what_happened: Scene: layout/style 7; squash_16 (round orange pumpkin, veg0) and squash_7 (butternut, veg1), drumsticks ChickenDrumstick014/011; the two tupperwares stand ~1.2 m apart on the same counter (one by the toaster near the fridge, one farther left by a coffee machine). Stage 0: closed on the large pumpkin at 101 (width 0.026, no lift), carried on with closed empty fingers (120-392) and made an empty place over the toaster-side tupperware (~400). Back at the fridge it grasped drumstick meat0 at 581-589 and released it at 725 into the toaster-side tupperware (dist 0.13); stage 0 complete 759 (typical 286, p90 339). Stage 1: grasped the pumpkin at 972 and released it at 1107 into the far tupperware (dist 0.17 -> 0.03); stage 1 complete 1148 (389 steps, normal). So far the composition was right (meat | veg). Stage 2: from 1148 to ~1920 (~770 steps) the robot hovered in front of the counter and drifted slowly back toward the fridge without doing anything (1160-1840). At the fridge it closed on air above the drumstick meat1 at 2039, carried the closed empty fingers back to the toaster-side tupperware and made an empty place there (~2220, brushing meat0 2219-2224). It then returned, grasped meat1 at 2448-2458 and released it at 2586 into the toaster-side tupperware, i.e. next to meat0 (two meats in one tupperware, dist 0.02). At 2600 the gripper was still within 25 cm, so stage 2 (3 items) is not counted; the butternut veg1 was never touched.
causal_chain: missed pumpkin + empty place made stage 0 slow (759) -> stage 1 normal (1148) -> ~770 steps of idle hovering/drifting at the counter (1148-1920) -> close on air (2039) + empty place (~2220) -> third item only at 2586, and into the tupperware that already held a meat -> timeout at 2600 (gripper still near, 4th item untouched); stage 3 would have failed anyway because of two meats together
self_recovery: After each failure it returned to the fridge (after the empty place at ~400 and at ~2220) and the next grasp worked, but each cost 300-500 steps.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 2 is false at the end only because of the gripper-distance clause: three items are in tupperwares from 2587, the release was at 2586 and the episode ended 14 steps later.
